Postings from ATS boards, Hacker News, RemoteOK, and search discovery must name one of these in the title (whole words; the last word also takes common endings). "Associate" passes only beside a family word.
Target Role Families
  • data
  • AI/ML
  • software
  • product management
  • consulting/strategy
Given to the prescreen and the review: postings in these families are judged on what the role asks for, and a product or consulting role is not marked down for not being a data role. The score bands stay the same.
Excluded Title Words
  • senior
  • staff
  • principal
  • lead
  • manager
  • director
A posting whose title has one of these words is left out (senior, staff, manager, ...); new grad, early career and the other override phrases lift the manager and level exclusions.
